; Folderz 1.0 - My Files popup + go/return for reMarkable Paper Pro 3.28 (no native code).
; Author: Nick Greenfield
; Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later
; Document open calls follow alefaraci's linkFromSelection / navHistory (GPL-3.0-only):
;   research/alefaraci/3.28/linkFromSelection.qmd
;   research/alefaraci/3.28/navHistory.qmd  (explorer.open)
; Overlay INSERT into DocumentView follows Stickerz 1.0 / rm-stickers v3.1.
; Cross-document return state is stored as primitives on the long-lived root
; ~&254540341572282132&~ (navigator), NOT on the DocumentView instance.
; Every hashed token below is copied from mods published for 3.28 (see README "Evidence").
; Coexists with Stickerz 1.0: this mod's icon sits LEFT of Stickerz (rightMargin 220 vs 120).
; FolderListModel IMPORT + folder/count/get hashes from ingatellent imageStickers 3.28.
; Metadata tree is built by reading xochitl *.metadata via FolderListModel + XMLHttpRequest
; (XHR open/send + JSON.parse hashes from linkFromSelection 3.28).

; --- Persistent open/return helpers on navigator root ---
AFFECT [[8850026134298937527]]
	TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]
	LOCATE BEFORE ALL
	INSERT {
		/* Folderz primitives on the long-lived root (same pattern as Stickerz stk*). */
		property string fldBackDoc: ""
		property int fldBackPage: 0
		property int fldJump: -1
		property string fldJumpDoc: ""
		function fldOpenDoc(docId, pageIdx) {
			try {
				var d = ~&233694067165438&~.~&8399431778896295215&~(docId);
				if (!d) return "Notebook not found in My Files";
				if (d.~&7712810854541167&~) return "Notebook not downloaded yet";
				~&254540341572282132&~.fldJumpDoc = docId;
				~&254540341572282132&~.fldJump = pageIdx;
				~&254540341572282132&~.~&9497240032101537789&~(d, pageIdx);
				return "";
			} catch (e) { return "Could not open: " + e; }
		}
		function fldOpenByExplorer(docId) {
			try {
				var d = ~&233694067165438&~.~&8399431778896295215&~(docId);
				if (!d) return "Notebook not found in My Files";
				if (d.~&7712810854541167&~) return "Notebook not downloaded yet";
				~&254540341572282132&~.~&7712989590835962&~.~&6504147419&~(docId);
				return "";
			} catch (e) { return "Could not open: " + e; }
		}
		function fldClearBack() {
			~&254540341572282132&~.fldBackDoc = "";
			~&254540341572282132&~.fldBackPage = 0;
		}
	}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; --- DocumentView overlay: folder button, back button, My Files popup ---
AFFECT [[11806562588218124596]]
	IMPORT Qt.labs.folderlistmodel [[180923.180930]]
	TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]]
	LOCATE AFTER ALL
	INSERT {
		Item {
			id: fldLayer
			anchors.fill: parent
			z: 99998
			/* Sit under Stickerz (z 99999) for message stacking; icons do not overlap. */

			property string msg: ""
			property bool popupOpen: false
			property bool loading: false
			property int loadIdx: 0
			property int loadTotal: 0
			property var entries: []
			property var expanded: ({})
			property var treeRows: []
			property string docIdNow: {
				var d = ~&6504254477&~.~&7712934851008712&~;
				return (d && d.~&5972374&~) ? String(d.~&5972374&~) : "";
			}
			property int pageNow: {
				try { return ~&6504254477&~.~&6504167078&~; } catch (e) { return 0; }
			}
			property bool hasBack: {
				var b = ~&254540341572282132&~.fldBackDoc;
				return b && b !== "";
			}

			FolderListModel {
				id: fldMetaFiles
				~&7082663378949&~: "file:///home/root/.local/share/remarkable/xochitl"
				nameFilters: ["*.metadata"]
				showDirs: false
				sortField: FolderListModel.~&6502945418&~
			}

			function openDoc(id, pageIdx) {
				var err = ~&254540341572282132&~.fldOpenDoc(id, pageIdx);
				if (err !== "") { msg = err; return false; }
				return true;
			}
			function openByExplorer(id) {
				var err = ~&254540341572282132&~.fldOpenByExplorer(id);
				if (err !== "") { msg = err; return false; }
				return true;
			}

			property int jumpTries: 0
			function tryJump() {
				var want = ~&254540341572282132&~.fldJump;
				if (want < 0) return;
				if (!~&6504254477&~.~&7712934851008712&~) return;
				if (docIdNow !== ~&254540341572282132&~.fldJumpDoc) {
					if (++jumpTries > 20) { ~&254540341572282132&~.fldJump = -1; jumpTries = 0; }
					return;
				}
				~&254540341572282132&~.fldJump = -1; jumpTries = 0;
				if (pageNow === want) return;
				try {
					~&6504254477&~.~&7713405014271992&~(want, ~&14175747548438644067&~.~&10593835380864769165&~.~&7442916920529273295&~);
				} catch (e) { msg = "Page jump failed: " + e; }
			}
			Timer { interval: 250; repeat: true; running: ~&254540341572282132&~.fldJump >= 0; onTriggered: fldLayer.tryJump() }
			Component.onCompleted: tryJump()

			function goBack() {
				var doc = ~&254540341572282132&~.fldBackDoc;
				var page = ~&254540341572282132&~.fldBackPage;
				if (!doc || doc === "") {
					msg = "No return notebook - use the X to close";
					return;
				}
				~&254540341572282132&~.fldClearBack();
				openDoc(doc, page);
			}

			function openPopup() {
				popupOpen = true;
				startLoad();
			}
			function closePopup() {
				popupOpen = false;
				loading = false;
				loadTimer.stop();
			}

			function startLoad() {
				entries = [];
				treeRows = [];
				expanded = { "": true };
				loadIdx = 0;
				loadTotal = fldMetaFiles.~&214622615378&~;
				loading = true;
				if (loadTotal <= 0) {
					msg = "My Files is empty or still loading";
					loading = false;
					rebuildTree();
					return;
				}
				loadTimer.start();
			}

			function loadOne() {
				if (loadIdx >= loadTotal) {
					loading = false;
					loadTimer.stop();
					rebuildTree();
					return;
				}
				var fname = fldMetaFiles.~&197086313&~(loadIdx, "fileName");
				var furl = fldMetaFiles.~&197086313&~(loadIdx, "fileUrl");
				loadIdx++;
				if (!fname || !furl) return;
				var id = String(fname).replace(".metadata", "");
				if (!id || id.length < 8) return;
				var req = new XMLHttpRequest();
				req.~&6504147419&~("GET", furl);
				var capturedId = id;
				req.onreadystatechange = function() {
					if (req.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
					try {
						var txt = req.responseText || "";
						var obj = ~&6502785411&~.parse(txt);
						if (!obj) return;
						var typ = obj.type || "";
						if (typ !== "DocumentType" && typ !== "CollectionType") return;
						if (obj.deleted === true) return;
						var parent = (obj.parent === undefined || obj.parent === null) ? "" : String(obj.parent);
						if (parent === "trash") return;
						var name = obj.visibleName ? String(obj.visibleName) : capturedId;
						var list = fldLayer.entries.slice(0);
						list.push({
							id: capturedId,
							name: name,
							type: typ,
							parent: parent,
							isFolder: typ === "CollectionType"
						});
						fldLayer.entries = list;
					} catch (e) { /* skip unreadable metadata */ }
				};
				req.~&6504279475&~();
			}

			Timer {
				id: loadTimer
				interval: 5
				repeat: true
				running: false
				onTriggered: {
					/* Load a few per tick so a large library does not freeze the UI. */
					for (var n = 0; n < 8; n++) {
						if (!fldLayer.loading) break;
						fldLayer.loadOne();
						if (!fldLayer.loading) break;
					}
				}
			}

			function childList(parentId) {
				var out = [];
				var all = entries;
				for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
					if (all[i].parent === parentId) out.push(all[i]);
				}
				out.sort(function(a, b) {
					if (a.isFolder !== b.isFolder) return a.isFolder ? -1 : 1;
					var an = a.name.toLowerCase();
					var bn = b.name.toLowerCase();
					if (an < bn) return -1;
					if (an > bn) return 1;
					return 0;
				});
				return out;
			}

			function rebuildTree() {
				var rows = [];
				var exp = expanded;
				function walk(parentId, depth) {
					var kids = fldLayer.childList(parentId);
					for (var i = 0; i < kids.length; i++) {
						var e = kids[i];
						rows.push({
							id: e.id,
							name: e.name,
							type: e.type,
							depth: depth,
							isFolder: e.isFolder,
							open: !!(exp[e.id])
						});
						if (e.isFolder && exp[e.id]) walk(e.id, depth + 1);
					}
				}
				walk("", 0);
				treeRows = rows;
			}

			function toggleFolder(id) {
				var exp = {};
				for (var k in expanded) exp[k] = expanded[k];
				exp[id] = !exp[id];
				expanded = exp;
				rebuildTree();
			}

			function pickEntry(row) {
				if (!row) return;
				if (row.isFolder) {
					toggleFolder(row.id);
					return;
				}
				/* Remember where we came from, then open the chosen notebook. */
				if (!hasBack) {
					~&254540341572282132&~.fldBackDoc = docIdNow;
					~&254540341572282132&~.fldBackPage = pageNow;
				}
				closePopup();
				openByExplorer(row.id);
			}

			Timer { id: fldMsgTimer; interval: 3500; running: fldLayer.msg !== ""; onTriggered: fldLayer.msg = "" }

			/* Folder / Back button: top-right, LEFT of Stickerz (Stickerz uses rightMargin 120). */
			Rectangle {
				id: fldGo
				visible: !fldLayer.hasBack
				width: 88; height: 88; radius: 12
				anchors.top: parent.top
				anchors.topMargin: 16
				anchors.right: parent.right
				anchors.rightMargin: 220
				color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 3
				Canvas {
					id: fldGoIcon
					anchors.fill: parent
					anchors.margins: 14
					onPaint: {
						var ctx = getContext("2d");
						var w = width, h = height;
						ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
						ctx.strokeStyle = "#000000";
						ctx.fillStyle = "#000000";
						ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2.5, w / 18);
						ctx.lineJoin = "round";
						ctx.lineCap = "round";
						var s = w / 160;
						function X(x) { return x * s; }
						function Y(y) { return y * s; }
						/* tab */
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.moveTo(X(28), Y(48));
						ctx.lineTo(X(28), Y(38));
						ctx.lineTo(X(70), Y(38));
						ctx.lineTo(X(82), Y(48));
						ctx.closePath();
						ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
						ctx.fill();
						ctx.stroke();
						/* body */
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.moveTo(X(28), Y(48));
						ctx.lineTo(X(132), Y(48));
						ctx.lineTo(X(132), Y(122));
						ctx.lineTo(X(28), Y(122));
						ctx.closePath();
						ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
						ctx.fill();
						ctx.stroke();
						/* open flap hint */
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.moveTo(X(28), Y(60));
						ctx.lineTo(X(132), Y(60));
						ctx.stroke();
					}
					Component.onCompleted: requestPaint()
					onWidthChanged: requestPaint()
					onHeightChanged: requestPaint()
				}
				MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: fldLayer.openPopup() }
			}

			/* Back button: same slot as folder icon when a return target is set. Icon 4 style. */
			Rectangle {
				id: fldBackBtn
				visible: fldLayer.hasBack
				width: 88; height: 88; radius: 12
				anchors.top: parent.top
				anchors.topMargin: 16
				anchors.right: parent.right
				anchors.rightMargin: 220
				color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 3
				Canvas {
					id: fldBackIcon
					anchors.fill: parent
					anchors.margins: 14
					onPaint: {
						var ctx = getContext("2d");
						var w = width, h = height;
						ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
						ctx.strokeStyle = "#000000";
						ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
						ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2.5, w / 18);
						ctx.lineJoin = "round";
						ctx.lineCap = "round";
						var s = w / 160;
						function X(x) { return x * s; }
						function Y(y) { return y * s; }
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.rect(X(70), Y(25), X(130) - X(70), Y(135) - Y(25));
						ctx.fill();
						ctx.stroke();
						ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, w / 36);
						for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
							var y = 45 + i * 18;
							ctx.beginPath();
							ctx.moveTo(X(82), Y(y));
							ctx.lineTo(X(118), Y(y));
							ctx.stroke();
						}
						ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, w / 14);
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.moveTo(X(20), Y(80));
						ctx.lineTo(X(62), Y(80));
						ctx.stroke();
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.moveTo(X(20), Y(80));
						ctx.lineTo(X(40), Y(62));
						ctx.stroke();
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.moveTo(X(20), Y(80));
						ctx.lineTo(X(40), Y(98));
						ctx.stroke();
					}
					Component.onCompleted: requestPaint()
					onWidthChanged: requestPaint()
					onHeightChanged: requestPaint()
				}
				MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: fldLayer.goBack() }
			}

			/* Toast */
			Rectangle {
				visible: fldLayer.msg !== ""
				anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
				anchors.top: parent.top
				anchors.topMargin: 120
				width: fldMsgText.implicitWidth + 48; height: 72; radius: 12
				color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 3
				z: 2
				Text { id: fldMsgText; anchors.centerIn: parent; text: fldLayer.msg; font.pixelSize: 28; color: "black" }
			}

			/* My Files popup */
			Rectangle {
				id: fldPopupScrim
				visible: fldLayer.popupOpen
				anchors.fill: parent
				color: "#000000"
				opacity: 0.25
				z: 3
				MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: fldLayer.closePopup() }
			}
			Rectangle {
				id: fldPopup
				visible: fldLayer.popupOpen
				anchors.centerIn: parent
				width: Math.min(parent.width - 80, 980)
				height: Math.min(parent.height - 120, 1400)
				radius: 16
				color: "white"
				border.color: "black"
				border.width: 3
				z: 4

				Text {
					id: fldTitle
					anchors.top: parent.top
					anchors.left: parent.left
					anchors.topMargin: 28
					anchors.leftMargin: 36
					text: "My Files"
					font.pixelSize: 40
					font.bold: true
					color: "black"
				}
				Text {
					anchors.left: fldTitle.right
					anchors.leftMargin: 24
					anchors.verticalCenter: fldTitle.verticalCenter
					visible: fldLayer.loading
					text: "Loading " + Math.min(fldLayer.loadIdx, fldLayer.loadTotal) + "/" + fldLayer.loadTotal
					font.pixelSize: 26
					color: "black"
				}
				Rectangle {
					id: fldClose
					width: 72; height: 72; radius: 12
					anchors.top: parent.top
					anchors.right: parent.right
					anchors.topMargin: 16
					anchors.rightMargin: 16
					color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 3
					Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "X"; font.pixelSize: 36; color: "black" }
					MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: fldLayer.closePopup() }
				}

				Flickable {
					id: fldFlick
					anchors.top: fldTitle.bottom
					anchors.topMargin: 24
					anchors.left: parent.left
					anchors.right: parent.right
					anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
					anchors.leftMargin: 12
					anchors.rightMargin: 12
					anchors.bottomMargin: 20
					clip: true
					contentWidth: width
					contentHeight: fldCol.height
					flickableDirection: Flickable.VerticalFlick
					boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds

					Column {
						id: fldCol
						width: fldFlick.width
						spacing: 4

						Repeater {
							model: fldLayer.treeRows
							delegate: Rectangle {
								width: fldCol.width
								height: 72
								radius: 8
								color: "white"
								border.color: "#cccccc"
								border.width: 1

								property var row: modelData

								Item {
									anchors.fill: parent
									anchors.leftMargin: 16 + (row && row.depth ? row.depth * 36 : 0)
									anchors.rightMargin: 16

									Text {
										id: fldGlyph
										anchors.left: parent.left
										anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
										width: 48
										text: row && row.isFolder ? (row.open ? "v" : ">") : "-"
										font.pixelSize: 32
										color: "black"
									}
									Text {
										anchors.left: fldGlyph.right
										anchors.leftMargin: 8
										anchors.right: parent.right
										anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
										text: row ? row.name : ""
										font.pixelSize: 30
										color: "black"
										elide: Text.ElideRight
									}
								}
								MouseArea {
									anchors.fill: parent
									onClicked: fldLayer.pickEntry(row)
								}
							}
						}

						Text {
							visible: !fldLayer.loading && fldLayer.treeRows.length === 0
							width: fldCol.width
							horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
							text: "No notebooks found"
							font.pixelSize: 28
							color: "black"
							padding: 24
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
